avglength.description: Length of averaging window in seconds for avg stat_type.

count.description: Number of outputs for plain/csv mode; 0 in csv mode skips initial zero output.

daemon.description: If true, fork into background (requires outfile).

diskstatsfile.description: Path to diskstats file used by disk input method.

html_header.description: If true, print full HTML header (including meta refresh).

html_refresh.description: HTML page refresh interval in seconds.

input_method.description: Input method for network data; e.g., proc, getifaddrs, kstat, sysctl, netstat, libstatgrab. Must be compiled-in.

interfaces.description: Comma-separated list of interface names. Prefix with '%' for blacklist.

outfile.description: Output file path (required for daemon mode with csv/html output).

output_method.description: Output method: curses, curses2, plain, csv, html.

partitionsfile.description: Path to partitions file used by disk input method on older kernels.

procfile.description: Path to proc file used by proc input method.

stat_type.description: Type of stats: rate, max, sum, avg.

sumhidden.description: If true, include hidden interfaces in totals.

unit.description: Unit to display: bytes, bits, packets, errors.
